tech1.title: Smart Control System
tech1.desc: Integrated control solution for industrial sites.
tech1.intro: Lua's smart control system provides real-time data collection, analysis, and control on a single platform. It can be customized for various industrial environments.

sections.title: Core Features
body: Supports real-time monitoring and remote control with unified multi-equipment management.
Edge computing ensures fast response and on-site stability.

sections.title: System Architecture
sections.body: Provides an end-to-end architecture connecting sensors, PLC, SCADA, and cloud seamlessly.

tech2.title: IoT Platform
tech2.desc: IoT platform for unified device and data management.
tech2.intro: Lua IoT Platform supports device connectivity, data collection, analysis, and visualization. Built on a scalable microservices architecture.

sections.title: Platform Overview
sections.body: Manage the entire lifecycle from device onboarding to dashboards via web interface. Supports both REST API and MQTT protocols.

sections.title: Field Applications
sections.body: Deployed and operating at numerous smart factory and energy sites domestically and internationally.
